description: Pay $0.005 USDC via x402 to call /v1/announcements/latest. Latest Binance announcements and new listings with AI sentiment scores. Without payment, returns payment requirements.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

name: pay_getLatestAnnouncements
